title: Music streamer Deezer says more than 50% of daily uploads are AI-generated
slides: What if half of new songs aren't human?
Deezer now tags AI-made tracks automatically.
Yet listeners cannot tell which is which.
Artists must confirm their work is human.
Check your uploads before they vanish tomorrow.
thread_text:
What if half is AI?

Deezer has begun tagging AI-generated songs automatically — without waiting for artists to declare them.

Listeners can't tell.

In blind tests, people guessed wrong as often as right. The ear is useless here.

Artists must prove humanity.

New uploads now require a manual confirmation: "This work is human-made." The burden shifted.

Uploads vanish tomorrow.

Any track without a human declaration will be removed. No grace period. No appeal.

Check your own feed.

Scroll your last uploads. Could you tell which ones are synthetic? If you're wrong, tomorrow they're gone.

instagram.caption:
Half of the songs uploaded to Deezer every day are now made by AI, not people.

The company has started tagging synthetic tracks automatically without waiting for artists to label them. In blind tests, listeners couldn't tell the difference between human and AI music.

Artists now have to manually check a box saying "this work is human-made" for every new upload. Any track without that declaration gets removed tomorrow — no appeal.

Scroll your last uploads. 🎧 Could you honestly tell which ones are real? ♻️
